plugins.name: issue-pipeline
plugins.description: Issue-to-PR pipeline: the ship, review, score and setup skills, with a run guard on Bash.

plugins.name: check-gate
plugins.description: Mod: reruns the repo's check after code changes and stops git commit while it fails in the repo the commit lands in, or when it can't tell which repo that is.

plugins.name: citation-guard
plugins.description: Mod for warhammer: asks for a CITATIONS.md entry when an edit changes a game value.

plugins.name: boe-guard
plugins.description: Mod for boe-agent: refuses whole reads of the long docs and asks before a BDNS or BOE month load.

plugins.name: forja-cost-guard
plugins.description: Mod for forja: asks before a GPU rental, shows the running cost, reminds to clean up.

plugins.name: digest-guard
plugins.description: Mod for ai-digest: keeps mailbox identifiers out of site/ and Gmail tools read-only.

plugins.name: mcp-inspector
plugins.description: Mod for mcp-lab: a pane of MCP tool calls with error codes and a personal-data flag.

plugins.name: jev-status
plugins.description: Mod: local-jev up or down in the status line, and /jev-start.

plugins.name: pipeline-pane
plugins.description: Mod: a pane showing where an issue-pipeline /ship run stands.

plugins.name: humanizer
plugins.description: Mod: a writing reminder on each prompt, rewrite feedback on prose files, a refusal when a commit message or PR text has a strong tell or a commit adds a prose line with any tell, a note on closing messages, and the humanizer rewriting skill.

plugins.name: guards
plugins.description: Mod: asks before a git command that throws away uncommitted work, and refuses a test or check run piped into a filter that hides its exit status, a /tmp path outside the session scratchpad in a Bash command or a file write, and a gh pr merge into a branch other than the default one.
